description: This file defines interfaces, macros, and includes external cryptographic libraries (OpenSSL, mbed TLS, wolfSSL) for cryptographic operations, including cipher management and buffer handling.

methods.name: hexstr2buf
methods.description: Converts a hexadecimal string to a buffer, returning the buffer and setting length.

methods.name: get_default_cipher
methods.description: Returns the default cipher to be used.

methods.name: get_cipher_or_print_error
methods.description: Returns a cipher based on the provided name, or prints an error.

methods.name: get_cipher_ivsize
methods.description: Gets the initialization vector size of the cipher.

methods.name: get_cipher_keysize
methods.description: Gets the key size of the cipher.

methods.name: create_ctx
methods.description: Creates and initializes a cryptographic context with specified parameters.

methods.name: do_crypt
methods.description: Performs encryption or decryption on input file and writes to output file.

methods.name: free_ctx
methods.description: Frees the cryptographic context to release resources.
